<script>
(()=>{const D=document,W=window,FM=W.__CUSTOMRoundFloatManager||(W.__CUSTOMRoundFloatManager={items:[],raf:0,bound:0,observer:null,scanTimer:0,buffer:240});
FM.buffer=240;
FM.schedule=()=>{if(FM.raf)return;FM.raf=W.requestAnimationFrame(()=>{FM.raf=0;FM.update()})};
function getLimits(){const topLimit=D.querySelector('.topTabbar').getBoundingClientRect().bottom,bottomLimit=D.querySelector('.chat-bottom').getBoundingClientRect().top;return{top:topLimit,bottom:bottomLimit}}
function isNear(reply,topLimit,bottomLimit){const r=reply.getBoundingClientRect(),b=FM.buffer;return r.bottom>=topLimit-b&&r.top<=bottomLimit+b}
FM.update=()=>{const lim=getLimits(),vw=W.innerWidth;FM.items=FM.items.filter(x=>x.anchor&&x.anchor.isConnected&&x.float&&x.reply);D.querySelectorAll('.item.Ai .content.left').forEach(reply=>{if(isNear(reply,lim.top,lim.bottom))createFloat(reply)});FM.items=FM.items.filter(x=>{if(isNear(x.reply,lim.top,lim.bottom))return true;x.float.remove();return false});FM.items.forEach(x=>positionFloat(x,vw,lim.top,lim.bottom))};
function positionFloat(x,vw,topLimit,bottomLimit){const f=x.float,r=x.reply.getBoundingClientRect(),g=8,w=34,h=34;if(r.bottom<=topLimit||r.top>=bottomLimit){f.style.display='none';return}f.style.display='flex';f.style.left=Math.max(g,Math.min(vw-w-g,r.right+g))+'px';f.style.top=Math.max(topLimit+g,Math.min(bottomLimit-h-g,r.bottom-h))+'px'}
function scrollReplyCenter(reply){const m=D.createElement('span');m.style.display='block';m.style.height='0';reply.insertBefore(m,reply.firstChild);m.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});m.remove()}
function createFloat(reply){if(reply.querySelector('.tp263031-round-float'))return;const f=D.createElement('div'),b=D.createElement('button');f.className='tp263031-round-float';b.type='button';b.className='tp263031-round-up';b.textContent='▲';b.addEventListener('click',ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();scrollReplyCenter(reply)});f.appendChild(b);reply.appendChild(f);FM.items.push({anchor:reply,float:f,reply:reply})}
FM.scheduleScan=()=>{if(FM.scanTimer)clearTimeout(FM.scanTimer);FM.scanTimer=setTimeout(()=>{FM.scanTimer=0;FM.schedule()},100)};
if(!FM.bound){FM.bound=1;D.addEventListener('scroll',FM.schedule,true);W.addEventListener('resize',FM.schedule);FM.observer=new MutationObserver(FM.scheduleScan);FM.observer.observe(D.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});FM.schedule()}
})()
</script>
